commits.subject: Keep the TUI responsive while opening saved side chats (#60599)
commits.reason: Retain bounded background saved-chat preparation on its captured app-server connection, with request UUID plus backend/thread/channel identity and current chooser intent checked before installation. Abandoned or superseded attempts release unclaimed subscriptions on their original request handle and serialize reopening; only the latest waiting target starts after a slot frees. Anchored paginated history avoids replaying events received after subscription, attachment-prefix buffering retains late deltas/approvals, and newer settings/read receipts/turn/close observations win over snapshots. Reconnect/backend change, archive and focus changes cancel intent; permission-root and Windows setup selection gates remain. Held-key guards transfer with replaced widgets. Upstream extracted attachment modules provide a cleaner extension boundary; no ALab production adapter or new default is required by source review.
commits.revisit: Qualify nonblocking composer/navigation/notifications during open, bounded waiting/retry/supersession, original-connection release after fork/reconnect, stale runtime close and approval replay, newer read receipts/settings, anchored empty cursors and delta coalescing at eviction boundaries. Verify actual aterm rendering/input and native source lifetime separately; a conflict-free merge is not execution evidence.
